standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: This week, Paul (from Brisbane, Australia) and Annette (from Toulouse, France) tell us about their friendship on different sides of the world.
entries.zh: 本周，保罗（来自澳大利亚布里斯班）和安妮特（来自法国图卢兹）为我们讲述他们在地球两端的友谊。

entries.en: When and how did your friendship start?
entries.zh: 你们的友谊是什么时候、怎样开始的？

entries.en: Fifteen years ago! We were both fourteen.
entries.zh: 15 年前！我们那时都 14 岁。

entries.en: My school in Australia and her school in France started a virtual exchange programme for people to write to each other over the internet.
entries.zh: 我所在的澳大利亚学校和她的法国学校发起了一个虚拟交流项目，让人们通过互联网互相写信。

entries.en: I wanted to improve my English and he wanted to improve his French, so we contacted each other.
entries.zh: 我想提高英语，他想提高法语，所以我们联系上了。

entries.en: Did you become friends immediately?
entries.zh: 你们立刻就成了朋友吗？

entries.en: Not really.
entries.zh: 不算。

entries.en: I thought he was OK but not special.
entries.zh: 我觉得他还行，但并不特别。

entries.en: He made lots of mistakes in his French! Haha.
entries.zh: 他法语里犯了好多错误！哈哈。

entries.en: We corrected each other’s mistakes.
entries.zh: 我们互相纠正错误。

entries.en: But I made more than her! She corrected everything, too!
entries.zh: 但我犯得比她多！她什么都纠正！

entries.en: Paul always helped me to improve my English, but you know, after a few months, we stopped worrying about writing in perfect English or French and just wrote to each other and talked about ourselves.
entries.zh: 保罗总是帮我提高英语，但你知道，几个月后，我们不再纠结于写出完美的英语或法语，只是互相写信、聊聊自己。

entries.en: I began to see that he was a very nice guy, easy-going and cheerful.
entries.zh: 我开始发现他是个很好的人，随和又开朗。

entries.en: Did you feel the same way, Paul?
entries.zh: 你也有同样的感觉吗，保罗？

entries.en: Yes, I did.
entries.zh: 是的。

entries.en: She often made jokes that made me laugh.
entries.zh: 她经常讲笑话逗我笑。

entries.en: She’s really funny.
entries.zh: 她真的很有趣。

entries.en: And we saw that we had a lot of things in common – books we liked, films we liked, things like that.
entries.zh: 而且我们发现我们有很多共同点——喜欢的书、喜欢的电影之类的。

entries.en: He’s also very intelligent.
entries.zh: 他还很聪明。

entries.en: So, when did you actually meet face-to-face?
entries.zh: 那你们到底什么时候见面的？

entries.en: Last year.
entries.zh: 去年。

entries.en: We met in Singapore.
entries.zh: 我们在新加坡见的。

entries.en: That’s right.
entries.zh: 没错。

entries.en: We wanted to meet up, but it’s a long way and the plane tickets are expensive.
entries.zh: 我们想见面，但路途遥远，机票又贵。

entries.en: So we decided to meet halfway.
entries.zh: 所以我们决定在中途见面。

entries.en: We had a really great time together for about five days.
entries.zh: 我们一起度过了大约五天的美好时光。

entries.en: Which language did you speak?
entries.zh: 你们说什么语言？

entries.en: Haha! Good question.
entries.zh: 哈哈！好问题。

entries.en: English, almost all the time.
entries.zh: 几乎全是英语。

entries.en: Her English is really good!
entries.zh: 她的英语特别好！

entries.en: He’s just being kind! But yes, we had a great time.
entries.zh: 他只是客气罢了！不过是的，我们玩得很开心。

entries.en: I think we’re going to be friends for life.
entries.zh: 我想我们会做一辈子的朋友。

entries.en: I hope we can meet up again soon.
entries.zh: 希望我们很快还能再见面。
